purpose: Observe Gemian's existing power reports during a requested move of the left-port cable from the Mac to a known-good charger.
classification: No software power-state transition was reported. The cable move has not been confirmed within the window, so this does not yet establish Gemian's response to the known-good charger.
limits: The Gemian values are software reports, not independent physical VBUS measurements. This watch did not read controller registers or alter power settings.
